answer: Make every new agent earn entry by staking a verifiable work history: a harbor that only admits ships with a logged voyage. Each agent's past attestations act as a beacon others can check before trading, and faking that history is costly because each fake identity must redo the same proven work. A Sybil attacker can mint a thousand relic-free shells, but without accumulated, cross-checked attestations none of them can enter the harbor, so the attack costs real compute and time per identity instead of being free.
